phase_1.title: Phase 1 · AK-74M Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.45×39mm M74 primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 380 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 380 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 415 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 900 m/s (1380 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the AK-74M staged for its 650 RPM cyclic · low-impulse burst control cadence.

zh.headline: 卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪：1991 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 1991 年定型的 AK-74M 将固定托、折叠托与夜视导轨型合而为一，采用玻纤增强黑色聚酰胺左侧折叠枪托、标配燕尾侧镜轨以及革命性的双室膨胀膛口制退补偿器，使 5.45mm 自动点射上跳锐减近半。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：AK-74M 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1991 年问世的 卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪 由俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械制造厂（Kalashnikov Concern）主导研制，定位为经典的突击步枪。AK-74M 自 1991 年起作为俄军标准制式步枪服役逾三十年，其双室膨胀制退器的气动构型直接影响了此后全球无数步枪膛口装置设计。
1991 年定型的 AK-74M 将固定托、折叠托与夜视导轨型合而为一，采用玻纤增强黑色聚酰胺左侧折叠枪托、标配燕尾侧镜轨以及革命性的双室膨胀膛口制退补偿器，使 5.45mm 自动点射上跳锐减近半。 整件装备总长 943 mm（展开）/ 700 mm（左侧折叠托）、空重 3.4 kg，成为同期突击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1991 年，俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械制造厂（Kalashnikov Concern）推出了划时代的卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪。AK-74M 自 1991 年起作为俄军标准制式步枪服役逾三十年，其双室膨胀制退器的气动构型直接影响了此后全球无数步枪膛口装置设计。 它的核心设计聚焦于双室不对称喷口制退器利用火药燃气反推，显著抵消后坐冲量与右上跳，奠定了其在突击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「长行程导气活塞 · 90° 导气孔与双室高效膛口制退补偿器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。90° 垂直导气箍避免高初速 5.45mm 弹头被甲在斜孔处发生削铜变形，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪 采用长行程导气活塞 · 90° 导气孔与双室高效膛口制退补偿器。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了90° 垂直导气箍避免高初速 5.45mm 弹头被甲在斜孔处发生削铜变形。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.45×39mm M74 弹药规格与 415 mm 镀铬冷锻枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 200 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 380 MPa，可赋予弹头 900 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,380 J 动能，有效作用距离达 500 米。
内膛技术特点方面，90° 垂直导气孔配合 200 mm 急缠距稳定细长 5.45mm 7N6 钢芯弹头。同时，一体化左侧折叠黑色聚合物枪托搭配标配机匣左侧燕尾光学导轨，令其在 650 发/分（自动）· 点射散布大幅收敛 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 415 毫米身管与 5.45×39mm M74 口径，卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪 实现了每秒 900 米的初速与 500 米有效射程。90° 垂直导气孔配合 200 mm 急缠距稳定细长 5.45mm 7N6 钢芯弹头，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 43 mm 膛轴设计，卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74M 现代化突击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.5 N·s 水平。冲压铆接 1.0 mm 机匣加厚耳轴与光滑机匣盖显著提升结构疲劳寿命。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the AK-74M
paragraphs: Introduced in 1991 by Kalashnikov Concern (Izhmash) in Russia, the Kalashnikov AK-74M emerged as a defining Assault Rifle. Serving as Russia’s standard infantry rifle since 1991, the AK-74M’s dual-chamber expansion brake inspired decades of modern low-recoil rifle muzzle compensators worldwide.

Unified in 1991 to replace four separate AK-74 variants, the AK-74M combines a side-folding glass-filled polyamide stock, standard dovetail optics rail, and a pioneering dual-chamber expansion muzzle brake that halves automatic muzzle climb. Measuring 943 mm (Extended) / 700 mm (Side-Folded) at an unloaded weight of 3.4 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1991, Kalashnikov Concern (Izhmash) of Russia introduced the Kalashnikov AK-74M. Serving as Russia’s standard infantry rifle since 1991, the AK-74M’s dual-chamber expansion brake inspired decades of modern low-recoil rifle muzzle compensators worldwide. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Asymmetric dual-chamber expansion brake vents propellant gas to tame recoil and climb — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Kalashnikov AK-74M sits its Long-Stroke Gas Piston · 90° Gas Port & Dual-Chamber Muzzle Brake-Compensator. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 380 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 90° gas block eliminates jacket shearing on 900 m/s 5.45mm projectiles, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Kalashnikov AK-74M relies on Long-Stroke Gas Piston · 90° Gas Port & Dual-Chamber Muzzle Brake-Compensator. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 90° gas block eliminates jacket shearing on 900 m/s 5.45mm projectiles.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.45×39mm M74 with 415 mm Chrome-Lined Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:7.87" / 200 mm Twist), the Kalashnikov AK-74M develops 900 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,380 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 500 meters.

Internally, 90° vertical gas port prevents bullet-jacket shearing while 200 mm twist stabilizes long 5.45mm 7N6 projectiles. Combined with its 650 RPM cyclic · low-impulse burst control tempo, Side-folding black polyamide stock paired with standard left-side dovetail optic rail, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.45×39mm M74 through its 415 millimeter bore, the Kalashnikov AK-74M achieves 900 meters per second and 500 meters of effective reach. 90° vertical gas port prevents bullet-jacket shearing while 200 mm twist stabilizes long 5.45mm 7N6 projectiles.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 43 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.5 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Reinforced 1.0 mm stamped receiver and smooth dust cover extend service life.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-36), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
